definitions.explanation: Describes the frustration felt when something doesn't go as expected or desired, or when one cannot act as freely as they would like. Often involves impatience or the feeling that things are progressing too slowly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|うま}く→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{伝|つた}わらなくて→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧もどかしい。
examples.english: It's frustrating when I can't convey what I want to say properly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}くて→遅い：00533_osoi⟧もどかしい⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm feeling frustrated because my recovery is slow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧もどかしい。
examples.english: It's frustrating to wait for the results.

notes:
FORMS:
・もどかしい (plain form)
・もどかしく (adverbial form)
・もどかしさ (noun form - frustration)

NUANCE:
・Unlike ⟦{苛々|いらいら}→いらいら：01834_iraira⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (irritated), もどかしい often implies being unable to do anything about the situation
・Contains a sense of helplessness or powerlessness
・Can describe both self-directed frustration and frustration watching others

COMMON CONTEXTS:
・Communication difficulties (language barriers, etc.)
・Watching someone struggle when you can't help
・Slow progress in recovery, learning, etc.
・Waiting for results or outcomes
・Romantic situations where feelings can't be expressed

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦{歯|は}がゆい→歯がゆい：06628_hagayui⟧ (similar meaning - frustrating)
・⟦じれったい→じれったい：22590_jirettai⟧ (similar - frustrating/impatient)
・⟦やきもきする→やきもきする：noentry⟧ (anxious/restless)
・⟦{苛立|いらだ}つ→苛立つ：07912_iradatsu⟧ (to be irritated)

EXPRESSIONS:
・もどかしい⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to feel frustrated)
・もどかしい⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧ (frustrated feeling)

COLLOCATIONS:
・もどかしい⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧ (frustrated feeling)
・もどかしい⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧ (frustrating situation)
・もどかしい⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧ (frustratingly slow)
